raw_output:
alias: 客厅温度与窗帘控制
description: 当客厅窗户关闭且室温高于26度时，把空调设为24度并关闭窗帘。
triggers:
  - platform: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.living_window
    to: 'off'
  - platform: state
    entity_id: climate.living_ac
    attribute: current_temperature
    above: 26
conditions:
  - condition: and
    conditions:
      - condition: state
        entity_id: binary_sensor.living_window
        state: 'off'
      - condition: state
        entity_id: climate.living_ac
        attribute: current_temperature
        above: 26
actions:
  - service: climate.set_temperature
    target:
      entity_id: climate.living_ac
    data:
      temperature: 24
  - service: cover.close_cover
    target:
      entity_id: cover.living_curtain
mode: single
